description: The nutrition label for a dish on a UMD dining hall menu: serving size, calories, nutrition facts with daily values, ingredients and allergens. Use the id from nutrition_get_menu. No login needed.

id.description: Recipe identifier from a menu item, e.g. "060064*2"

name: nutrition_get_recipe

allergens.description: Allergens the label declares, e.g. "gluten", "soybeans", "sesame"; empty if none

ingredients.description: Ingredients in order of predominance, each keeping its sub-ingredients in parentheses, e.g. "Tofu (Water, Soybeans, Calcium Sulfate)"

nutrients.description: Nutrition facts per serving, in the order the label lists them

amount.description: Amount per serving, in `unit`; null if the label does not report it

daily_value.description: Percent of the recommended daily value, based on a 2,000-calorie diet; null if the label does not give one

name.description: Nutrient as printed on the label, e.g. "Total Fat", "Saturated Fat", "Sodium", "Vitamin C"

serving_size.description: Serving size as printed, e.g. "2 ea" or "4 oz"

title: Get a recipe's nutrition label
